description: The user-facing guide: the opt-in trigger, the portal overlay/stepper, the six step components with breakdown tooltips, and the overlay wiring inside SpellCastingPanel (own the useReducer, render the trigger per memorized castable row, host the extracted controls + OvercastAllocator in-body, suppress CastResultDisplay while the guide is open, and YIELD to RollDialog so only one aria-modal traps focus at a time). Plus the full component/integration test suite. Depends on FEAT-001 (reducer/advisor/helpers) and FEAT-002 (seam + extracted controls). CombatPage needs no edit (the panel owns the state).
steps: Create src/components/shared/GuidedCastTrigger.tsx (+ .module.css) mirroring GuidedTurnTrigger: native <button>, icon-only (Wand2 or Sparkles) on mobile via useMediaQuery('(max-width: 767px)'), label 'Guide my spell' on desktop, aria-label='Guide my spell', data-testid='guided-cast-trigger', onOpen prop.

Create src/components/shared/GuidedCastPanel.tsx (+ .module.css) mirroring GuidedTurnPanel: createPortal to document.body; role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label='Guide my spell'; focus trap on Tab/Shift-Tab; Esc + backdrop close (backdrop dispatches reset); focus to step heading (tabIndex=-1, requestAnimationFrame) on open and on each step change; focus restore to the trigger on close. Stepper <ol> over applicableSteps(state) with aria-current='step', per-step goto buttons, Arrow Left/Right over the applicable subset, Back/Next disabled at applicable boundaries, polite aria-live region. Derive isFirst/isLast from the applicable subset (NOT STEP_SEQUENCE). Unwrap advisor copy with `info instanceof Promise ? null : info`. Props: state, dispatch, character, spell, armourPenalty (getArmourCastingPenalty — context), saturation: MagicSaturation (imported from ../../types/character, resolved with ?? 'normal'), onOpenCast, onOpenChannel, onChooseCritical, onRollMiscast, onClose. Render the six step children; for Steps 4/5 host the FEAT-002 extracted controls + OvercastAllocator in-body.

Create src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/SelectStep.tsx — spell CN/Range/Target/Duration/Effect (same fields as SpellCard) + casting-target total from computeCastingTargetBreakdown with a breakdown tooltip (Int total + advances = total); if getArmourCastingPenalty > 0 show the armour-penalty note; show magic-saturation modifier as context only. No action.

Create src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/RouteStep.tsx — Cast + Channel buttons; Channel hidden when isPettySpell(spell). Cast dispatches chooseRoute('cast') then advances to 'resolve' and calls onOpenCast(); Channel dispatches chooseRoute('channel') and calls onOpenChannel(). Cited copy from the advisor.

Create src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/ResolveStep.tsx — 'Open Cast roll' button (onOpenCast); after resolve, show slAchieved/target/SL-vs-CN read verbatim from the CastingResult with breakdown tooltips (SL achieved: Roll vs target → SL; SL vs CN). Render the extracted CriticalChoiceButtons gated on result.isCriticalCast ALONE (NOT castSuccess), delegating to onChooseCritical.

Create src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/OvercastStep.tsx — surplus-SL budget + Fibonacci thresholds (1/2/3/5/8/13/21 from OVERCAST_TABLE); render the EXISTING OvercastAllocator in-body with options=computeOvercastOptions(spell) and availableSlots = state.result.overcastSlots read on EVERY render (never snapshotted); overcast-budget tooltip via computeOvercastBudgetBreakdown (SL + Total Power tens − CN = surplus, summing under Total Power); damage preview via computeOvercastDamagePreview with tooltip. On allocator confirm, forward to onOvercastResolved (host dispatches overcastResolved).

Create src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/MiscastStep.tsx — cited 'why' (Critical Core p.234 / Fumble Core p.234-235 / failed channelled cast WoM §Channelling Test); render the extracted MiscastRollButtons + MiscastEscalation wired to onRollMiscast / the panel's handleMiscastRoll + onArcaneMarkAcquired. On completion host dispatches miscastCompleted.

Create src/components/shared/guidedCastSteps/OutcomeStep.tsx — success/failure, SL vs CN, Critical/Fumble/Unstoppable Force (isUndispellable); for magic missiles hitLocation + damage via formatCastDamageBreakdown with a breakdown tooltip; chosen overcast effects via the EXISTING resolveOvercastAllocations(result.surplusSL, state.overcastAllocations) + lookupOvercastEffect (omit when overcastAllocations is null).

In SpellCastingPanel.tsx add useReducer(guidedCastReducer, initialGuidedCastState); render GuidedCastTrigger on each memorized castable row (the ONLY new default-render element); track guideActive. While guideActive, suppress the panel's own CastResultDisplay render (`{!guideActive && castingResult && <CastResultDisplay .../>}`). Make the guide overlay YIELD while rollDialogState != null so the RollDialog is the single top aria-modal and the guide's trap/backdrop go inert, resuming when the dialog closes. On close / spell change / un-memorize, dispatch reset (reuse the sanctioned set-state-in-effect eslint-disable mirroring Tooltip.tsx/CombatPage.tsx ONLY if genuinely needed). Pass onOpenCast/onOpenChannel/onChooseCritical/onRollMiscast to the overlay via the handle. CombatPage needs no edit.

Add src/components/shared/__tests__/GuidedCastTrigger.test.tsx and GuidedCastPanel.steps.test.tsx: default-off renders identically to today + exactly one trigger per memorized row (AC-1); opening shows Step 1 with casting-target total == computeCastingTarget(character) and a tooltip whose lines sum to it (AC-2); Step 2 offers Cast+Channel for non-Petty, Cast-only for Petty with citations (AC-3).

Add src/components/shared/__tests__/GuidedCastPanel.integration.test.tsx through SpellCastingPanel + GuidedCastPanel: Cast route opens the existing RollDialog (title 'Language (Magick)', correct base target), guide renders no dice (AC-5); while the Cast roll is open assert EXACTLY ONE aria-modal dialog focus-traps (the RollDialog), guide trap inert (design-loop MEDIUM-2); after a seeded manual roll Step 3 shows SL/CN/flags (AC-6); Critical choice renders on isCriticalCast alone incl. the passed-but-under-CN case; Total Power raises overcastSlots (Step 4 availableSlots updates on re-render + budget tooltip sums under Total Power); Unstoppable Force → isUndispellable in Step 6; critical_wound fires no onCastResolved; while guide open assert NO CastResultDisplay (aria-label='Cast Result') overlay is mounted and the in-body allocator + miscast/escalation buttons are reachable via the guide's Tab trap; backdrop click dispatches reset + restores focus; Overcast appears iff castSuccess && overcastSlots > 0 and disables self/touch columns exactly as computeOvercastOptions (AC-7/8); confirm fires onOvercastResolved (not onOvercastAllocated), result stays mounted, Step 6 shows effects via resolveOvercastAllocations; default-off regression: only onOvercastAllocated still nulls + closes as today; Miscast appears iff a trigger fires, cited reason shown, rolls via handleMiscastRoll (Math.random) with NO RollDialog opened for the miscast (AC-9); a11y assertions mirror GuidedTurnPanel.test.tsx (AC-16).

Run the full gate; fix any error surfaced (per fix-errors steering), confirm existing spell-casting / SpellCastingPanel.* / CastResultDisplay.* / combat-turn / assistant suites are green UNCHANGED, and clean up any temp files.
acceptance_criteria: Guide OFF (default): SpellCastingPanel renders/behaves identically to today plus exactly one opt-in trigger per memorized castable row; no other default-render change.
Six steps appear in RAW order; overcast step only when castSuccess && overcastSlots > 0; miscast step only when a trigger fired; navigation/stepper operate over the applicable subset.
All casting/channelling d100 rolls go through the existing RollDialog; the guide renders no dice; the miscast d100 / arcane-mark d10 stay on the existing Math.random handlers.

Exactly one aria-modal dialog focus-traps at any time: the guide yields to RollDialog while a roll is open, and CastResultDisplay is not mounted while the guide is open (the guide hosts the controls in-body).

Every calculated total shown (casting target, SL, SL-vs-CN, overcast budget, overcast damage preview, magic-missile damage) carries a breakdown tooltip whose additive lines sum to the total, incl. the Total-Power overcast case.

Nothing auto-applies or auto-advances; closing or changing the spell dispatches reset and leaves no persisted casting state; character changes go only through updateCharacter / cancelChannelling / onArcaneMarkAcquired.
The extracted controls reach the same handlers from the guide as from CastResultDisplay (no drift); the mandatory no-drift test (FEAT-002) still passes.
All four verify gates are clean and every existing test suite passes UNCHANGED.
verification: npx vitest --run  (all tests pass; existing suites unchanged)
npx eslint .  (0 errors; no new warnings beyond the 3 pre-existing)
findings: Implemented the opt-in 'Guide my spell' overlay end-to-end. New: GuidedCastTrigger (+css), GuidedCastPanel portal/stepper (+css) mirroring GuidedTurnPanel (role=dialog aria-modal, focus trap, Esc/backdrop reset, focus-to-heading on step change, Arrow/Back/Next over applicableSteps NOT STEP_SEQUENCE, polite live region, advisor Promise-guard), a shared BreakdownTotal (Tooltip/TooltipTriggerCell single-open) and the six guidedCastSteps (Select/Route/Resolve/Overcast/Miscast/Outcome). Every displayed total carries a breakdown tooltip sourced from the existing spell-casting calculators (computeCastingTargetBreakdown, computeOvercastBudgetBreakdown summing under Total Power, computeOvercastDamagePreview, formatCastDamageBreakdown). SpellCastingPanel now owns useReducer(guidedCastReducer), renders one trigger per expanded memorized castable row (the only new default-render element), dispatches castResolved at the three non-null setCastingResult sites (NOT critical_wound), dispatches miscastCompleted on handleMiscastRoll and overcastResolved on allocator confirm, suppresses CastResultDisplay while guideActive, and YIELDS the overlay while rollDialogState != null so exactly one aria-modal (the RollDialog) traps focus at a time (design MEDIUM-2). Reset on close / un-memorize via the sole sanctioned set-state-in-effect eslint-disable (mirrors Tooltip.tsx/CombatPage.tsx). No casting/channelling/overcast/miscast math forked — reused src/logic/spell-casting.ts and the FEAT-002 extracted castControls; miscast d100 / arcane-mark d10 stay on Math.random; Ritual Magic out of scope. CombatPage untouched. Tests: GuidedCastTrigger.test.tsx, GuidedCastPanel.steps.test.tsx, GuidedCastPanel.integration.test.tsx (AC-1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9 + MEDIUM-2 single-modal + default-off overcast regression). Gate clean: tsc --build --force --noEmit exit 0; npm run build ok; npx vitest --run 5499 passed / 510 files (existing suites unchanged, incl. castControls.nodrift); npx eslint . 0 errors, only the 3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings. No new eslint-disable beyond the one sanctioned set-state-in-effect.
